wstep: There is no recipe here for onions stewed in oil and then sealed in jars to keep.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
The NCHFP recommends canning low-acid foods, and tomatoes and tomato products, only according to the procedures in the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning.
There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.

akapity: All fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods.
Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for onions in oil in jars from a checked source.
